name: 175. Converse additionalModelRequestFields store reaches the outbound request (#7720) (converse-store)
description: The AWS SDK's ConverseInput has no store field, so a caller who needs zero data retention on an OpenAI model served over the Responses API (openai, azure, bedrock_mantle, the Bedrock OpenAI surface, openrouter) and routed through the /bedrock drop-in puts store:false in additionalModelRequestFields. BedrockConverseRequest.ToBifrostResponsesRequest (core/providers/bedrock/responses.go) only copied that map into ExtraParams["additionalModelRequestFieldPaths"], which only the Bedrock egress reads, so the outbound Responses body had no store and the provider applied its store:true default without any error. Each case sends store:false in additionalModelRequestFields and reads the logged raw_request (the harness profile stores raw requests) to assert the outbound body carries store:false. Red before the fix: raw_request has no store key. The Go-level pin is TestConverseAdditionalModelRequestFieldsStoreReachesParams.

item.name: /bedrock converse -> azure/gpt-4o-mini additionalModelRequestFields store false reaches outbound body - #7720

exec: pm.test('converse store azure: request succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text().slice(0, 500)).to.eql(200); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('converse store azure: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
// raw_request is the body Bifrost sent upstream. The log row is written by the batching writer and,
// for streams, filled in when the stream ends, so poll until it parses. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
// It may be stored as a JSON string of the JSON body, so unwrap up to twice.
function rawOf(j) { var rr = j.raw_request; for (var i = 0; i < 2 && typeof rr === 'string'; i++) { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } } return rr; }
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var rr = (!err && res.code === 200) ? rawOf(res.json()) : null;
if (rr && typeof rr === 'object') {

pm.test('converse store azure: outbound body carries store false', function () { pm.expect(rr.store, 'store missing from outbound raw_request (provider default store:true applies): ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 600)).to.eql(false); });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('converse store azure: raw_request logged', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' never carried a parseable raw_request: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text().slice(0, 500)))); });
if (reqId) { checkLog(0); }
